description: Monday 17:10: the notes of Monday's weekly catch-up with the commissioning editor gain two lines: the master now due on a later date and the number of stills she wants. Nothing announces it.

silent.description: The commissioning editor's post-call note on the weekly catch-up: the master moves to 18 December.
